newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Munford, Tenn..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Munford, Tenn..

text.p: Water and Sewer Revenue and Tax Bonds, Series 1997
NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Munford, Tennessee
purchase of the Municipality's $1,600,000 Water and Sewer Revenue and Tax Bonds, Series 1997, on an all or none basis, until 11:00 a.m., Central Time, on
at the Mayor's Office, Munford Municipal Building, 1397 Munford-Atoka Avenue, Munford, Tennessee 38058-0725, at which time and place the sealed bids will be opened and announced.

The Bonds shall be dated May 1, 1997 and will mature on May 1 in the years 1998 through 2017, inclusively. The Bonds shall be issued in registered form, in the denominations, bear interest payable at such times, mature in the amounts and bear such other details, as set forth in the Detailed Notice of Sale. No interest rate on the Bonds shall exceed eight percent (8%) per annum. The Bonds shall be designated as qualified tax-exempt obligations '' within the meaning and for the purpose of Section 265 of the United State Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended. The Bonds are callable on May 1, 2005 and at any time thereafter, as provided in the Detailed Notice of Sale.

Bidders must bid for all the Bonds, and no proposal for less than ninety-eight percent (98%) of the par amount and accrued interest to the date of delivery will be considered. The Bonds will be awarded on the sale date to the bidder whose bid complies with the Detailed Notice of Sale and results in the lowest net interest cost to the Municipality. The successful bidder will be required to forward an amount equal to two percent (2%) of the par amount of the Bonds ($32,000), payable to the Municipality as a guarantee of good faith, no later than the day following the sale date (as more fully described in the Detailed Notice of Sale).

The Bonds shall be payable from and be secured by a pledge of the Net Revenues of the water and sewer systems of the Municipality, subject to the prior pledge of such revenues to certain prior lien bonds (as more fully described in the Detailed Notice of Sale). In the event of a deficiency in said revenues, the Bonds shall be payable from unlimited ad valorem taxes to be levied on all taxable property within the corporate limits of the Municipality. For the prompt payment of principal, redemption premium, if any, and interest on the Bonds, the full faith and credit of the Municipality are irrevocably pledged.

The Municipality will furnish upon delivery of the Bonds the approving opinion of Bass, Berry & Sims PLC, Nashville, Tennessee, Bond Counsel to the Municipality, together with the usual closing documents, including a certificate that no litigation is pending affecting the validity of the Bonds.
Bidders must use the bid form or forms which, toge

with the Detailed Notice of Sale and the Preliminary Official Statement containing pertinent information relating to the issuance, sale and security of the Bonds, may be obtained from the undersigned at the above shown address, or from Sentinel Trust Company, Financial Advisor to the Municipality, 8122 Sawyer Brown Road, Nashville, Tennessee 37221 (615) 662-5129.
